serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I think he was somewhere around here…
Back in my college days, there was that one dealer that had a lot of different stuff on him. 
Maybe he would have the same stuff Mrs. Fisher was giving me. 
It’s a long shot, but it’s worth trying.
This will be the last time, I promise. One last try! I will finish it! 
I can feel I was getting close! But it wasn’t enough… {{wi}}No…
There was always something lacking…
Oh! There he is!
